confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings or current rates. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately solid; hotel and hostel rates vary widely by district and season. Cocktail and wine anchors lean on the local beer price relationship because direct bar pricing knowledge is weak. Local examples assume about 58 PHP to the US dollar. FX caveat: the 0.7002 rate for 14 Oct 2026 comes from a search summary attributing it to the rba.gov.au homepage; I could not open that page, a follow-up search could not confirm it, and the RBA statistics table I reached was stale (March 2026), so verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Visayas provincial-urban Philippine pricing, loosely benchmarked against Iloilo and Davao; hotel anchors reflect Cebu City proper rather than Mactan resort-area pricing.
